about.title: About
about.heroDesc: Smart Harvest combines machine learning, agricultural science, and farmer-first design to bring accurate, explainable crop predictions to every corner of Tamil Nadu.
about.missionDesc: Tamil Nadu farmers make high-stakes cultivation decisions every season based on experience and word-of-mouth — with very little access to data. Smart Harvest was built to change that. By translating decades of agricultural data into a simple, accurate, and explainable prediction tool, we help farmers plan better, spend smarter, and protect their livelihoods.
about.ctaDesc: Free to use. No registration required. Powered by Tamil Nadu agricultural data.
about.mlStep1Desc: You provide crop type, district, season, area, and expected inputs. These become feature vectors.
about.mlStep2Desc: Season codes, district-level soil indices, historical price trends, and rainfall averages are appended automatically.
about.mlStep3Desc: Our Random Forest and Gradient Boosting ensemble models output yield, total cost, revenue, and profit distributions.
about.mlStep4Desc: Based on the density of historical data for your district-crop-season combination, a confidence score is computed.
about.mlStep5Desc: A language model translates the prediction into a plain-language explanation in your chosen language.
about.disclaimer1: Predictions are based on historical patterns and do not account for unprecedented weather events, pest outbreaks, or policy changes.
about.disclaimer2: Smart Harvest provides advisory estimates only — not financial guarantees or crop insurance.
about.disclaimer3: Model accuracy varies by district and crop. Thanjavur Paddy has the highest confidence due to data richness.
about.disclaimer4: All data is anonymized and used only to improve prediction accuracy. No personally identifiable information is shared.
about.disclaimer5: We do not recommend specific chemical inputs, pesticides, or vendors. Consult a certified agronomist for advisory.
about.tech1Desc: Random Forest Regressor trained on 15+ years of Tamil Nadu Department of Agriculture yield, cost, and market data. Separately trained models for yield prediction and expense prediction.
about.tech2Desc: GPT-based explanation generation conditioned on crop, district, season, and prediction output. Supports English and Tamil to reach farmers at every literacy level.
about.tech3Desc: Structured data ingested from government datasets, mandi price APIs, and satellite-informed seasonal indices. Updated quarterly.
about.tech4Desc: Leave-one-season-out cross-validation. District-level back-testing on 2020–2023 yield data. Ongoing feedback loop from user predictions.
